name: wget
description: Downloads a URL and saves it straight to a file in the current directory. wget is designed for downloading: resuming an interrupted transfer, automatic retries, recursive download of a site. For testing an API, curl is better suited.

options.description: Output file name; -O - writes to standard output.
Directory to save the files in.
Carries on downloading in the background (log in wget-log).

example.output:
Continuing in background, pid 4521.
Output will be written to 'wget-log'.

options.description: Downloads every URL listed in a file.
Recursive download: follows the links in pages.
With -r, never goes up into parent directories (short form: -np).
Limits the download speed, for example 500k or 2m.

examples.explanation: Downloads the file into the current directory, with a progress bar.
Resumes the download where it stopped.
Downloads every URL in links.txt into the downloads directory.
